result.topic_en: A quotation from Lagrange's memoir on the numerical solution of equations, calling for a criterion to recognise commensurable divisors of third, fourth and higher degree, followed by numerical calculations of the integral of sqrt(sin x) dx, including a comparison with Euler's value.
result.transcription:
14.
Mr. de la Grange dans son excellent Memoire
sur la resolution des équations numeriques,
après avoir montrée que sa methode fait connoitre
les racines commensurables [-du-] non seulement du
premier degré mais aussi du second, continue:
„Il seroit à souhaiter que l'on put trouver
„aussi quelque caractere qui put servir à faire
„reconnoître les diviseurs commensurables du troi-
„sieme quatrieme &c. degré, lorsqu'il y en a
„dans [-les-] équations proposée: c'est du moins
„une recherche qui me paroit tres dignes d'occuper
„les Geometres.
Hist. de l'Ac. de Prusse
année 1768. p. 149.

items.english: It would be desirable that one could also find some criterion which could serve to recognise the commensurable divisors of the third, fourth, etc. degree, when there are any, in the proposed equations: it is at least an investigation which seems to me very worthy of occupying the geometers.
